title: Nearly 70% of PLI scheme segments on track, says NITI Aayog report
description:
A sector-wise assessment of PLI scheme shows that nearly 70 per cent of the targeted segments are on track, with particularly strong outcomes emerging in electronics, telecom and pharmaceuticals drugs, NITI Aayog said in a report on Thursday.
As of March 2026, cumulatively the scheme has attracted investments of Rs 2,40,138 crore, generated production worth Rs 22,66,412 crore, created employment for 8,49,069 individuals, and disbursed Rs 35,354 crore in incentives.
"The assessment indicates that the production linked incentive (PLI) scheme is beginning to generate meaningful additionality across several sectors.
"...the sector-wise assessment of PLI scheme indicates that nearly 70 per cent of the targeted segments are broadly on track, with particularly strong outcomes emerging in electronics, telecom and pharmaceuticals drugs," the report 'Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes' said.
